import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_MULTI_ACTION_FANOUT_002.json').read_text())['goal']
out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
assert out['compiler_mode']=='DETERMINISTIC_MULTI_ACTION_FANOUT_PLAN',out
assert out.get('clause_coverage_verified') is True,out
acts=out['controller_actions']
fan=[a for a in acts if a.get('type')=='invoke_capability_fanout']
assert len(fan)==1,acts
specs=fan[0]['args']['item_actions']
assert len(specs)==2,specs
caps=[s['action']['args']['capability_id'] for s in specs]
assert caps==['image.qr.generate.qrencode','auto.apt.zint'],caps
assert [s['source_field'] for s in specs]==['username','email'],specs
assert any(a.get('type')=='assert_runtime_fanout_artifacts_decode' for a in acts),acts
print('MULTI_ACTION_FANOUT_COMPILER_VERIFIED')
PY
